stories.title: Better buses to Deeside Industrial Park on the way, says First Minister
stories.summary: Plans to improve bus services to Deeside Industrial Park have been approved, the First Minister has confirmed. stories.title: Reform motion to remove Wales’ Presiding Officer rejected by the Senedd
stories.summary: Huw Irranca-Davies will remain in his role as the Senedd’s Senedd’s Llywydd, after MSs rejected a Reform UK motion to remove him following a bitter row over free speech and conduct in the Siambr. stories.title: Betsi staff afraid to speak out, review finds, as Unite says managers failed to listen
stories.summary: Staff at Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board are afraid to speak out or raise concerns, an independent review of the north Wales health board has found. The Independent Well-Led Review, published on Tuesday, described the board’s governance as “immature and ineffective”. stories.title: Welsh Government spent £30,000 asking where a parent’s job ends and a school’s begins, and only five took part
stories.summary: Twenty parents expressed interest in research meant to help define where a parent's job ends and a school's begins, but only five took part.

stories.title: Timms Review: Changes to disability benefit could affect 12,000 people in Flintshire
stories.summary: More than 12,000 people in Flintshire who get Personal Independence Payment (PIP) could see changes to how the benefit is assessed and paid, after a government review published today set out plans to overhaul it.
